claims.text: Amankora is a circuit through Bhutan broken across five lodges among the Himalayas.

findings.quote: A stay at Amankora is a slow pilgrimage circuit through Bhutan, broken across five lodges among the Himalayas.

claims.text: Amankora arrived in 2004 as the first international hospitality brand permitted to operate in Bhutan.

findings.quote: Amankora, as it became known, arrived in 2004 as the first international hospitality brand ever permitted to operate in the country.

claims.text: The Paro lodge opened first, with the full five-lodge circuit completed three years later.

findings.quote: The Paro lodge opened first, with the full five-property circuit completed three years later.

claims.text: The late Kerry Hill designed the lodges in the government-mandated style of whitewashed rammed-earth walls and wooden-framed windows.

findings.quote: The late Kerry Hill was brought in to design the lodges in the government-mandated style of whitewashed rammed-earth walls and wooden-framed windows.

claims.text: The open-plan bedrooms at Amankora Paro have a king-size bed, a wood-burning stove and banquette window seating.

findings.quote: Open-plan bedrooms feature a king-size bed, wood-burning stove and banquette window seating

claims.text: Amankora Paro has views of the snow-covered Jhomolhari mountain.

findings.quote: Views of the snow-covered Jhomolhari mountain

claims.text: The Paro spa has two storeys, five treatment rooms, a hot stone bath, sauna, steam room and yoga studio.

findings.quote: Two-storey spa with five treatment rooms, hot stone bath, sauna, steam room and yoga studio

claims.text: At each lodge restaurant there is an a la carte of Western and fusion dishes plus a rotating set menu that alternates between Bhutanese and another Asian cuisine, Indian at Paro.

findings.quote: an à la carte of Western options and fusion offerings, plus a rotating set menu that alternates between Bhutanese and another Asian cuisine (Indian at Paro, Thai at Thimphu).

claims.text: Most ingredients come from local farmers and the lodges' own kitchen gardens.

findings.quote: Most ingredients come from local farmers and the lodges' own kitchen gardens

claims.text: Tiger's Nest is a quick drive from the Paro lodge, as is the National Museum of Bhutan, housed inside a 17th-century watchtower.

findings.quote: In Paro, Tiger's Nest (the country's signature hike) is a quick drive away, as is the National Museum of Bhutan, housed inside a 17th-century watchtower.

claims.text: After the hike to Tiger's Nest, guests can have a recovery lunch at Amankora's Log Cabin in the shadow of the monastery.

findings.quote: Conclude the hike to Bhutan’s holiest pilgrimage site with a rejuvenating lunch in the shadows of the Tiger’s Nest at Amankora’s atmospheric Log Cabin

claims.text: The Himalayan Hot Stone Bath uses heated river stones lowered into the bath, and local Khempa herbs infuse the water.

findings.quote: Inspired by a tradition, where river stones are heated and lowered into the bath to release beneficial minerals, while local Khempa herbs infuse the water with their healing properties.

claims.text: The Amankora Paro dining room has a terrace overlooking the 17th-century Drukgyel Dzong.

findings.quote: Dining room with terrace overlooking the 17th-century Drukgyel Dzong

claims.text: The late Kerry Hill designed the lodges in the government-mandated style of whitewashed rammed-earth walls and wooden-framed windows.

findings.quote: The late Kerry Hill was brought in to design the lodges in the government-mandated style of whitewashed rammed-earth walls and wooden-framed windows.

claims.text: Travelers should expect long transfers to reach the lodges.

findings.quote: The common thread: a tolerance for long transfers to get here.

claims.text: Any trip to Bhutan requires a licensed guide and driver, which Amankora can arrange but guests are not required to book through it.

findings.quote: Any trip to the kingdom requires a licensed guide and driver, which Amankora can arrange, but isn't required to book through.

claims.text: There are no televisions in any room, nor a mini-bar.

findings.quote: There are no televisions in any room, nor a mini-bar.
